notes: All 756 physical subject rows / 686 family-card identities across 35 sections retain original Name, Team and 102 literal Rookie marks. Fifteen dual and fourteen triple autograph cards and three ten-subject books retain every signer, including the page-seven/eight continuation. All 147 odds categories retain Hobby / Hat-Trick columns and nulls. The sheet names no ratio unit; Base Card 4:1 remains literal. Three guide examples stay card-specific; a 25-copy statement does not establish serial marking or an unnamed color. September 18 UK availability is regional evidence, not a verified general release. Exhaustive parallel eligibility and numbering remain unverified.
Exhaustive parallel ladders and individual-card eligibility are unverified.
The odds table names Hobby and Hat-Trick but does not state a ratio unit; no computed per-pack odds.
September 18 availability is announced by the UK edition with a UK product link; general release date remains unverified.
The 25-copy Diego Maradona example names no color or serial marking; never convert it to /25.
